usage: The word 獸 (sau3) is a noun used to refer to a beast or animal, often implying a wild or fierce creature.
獸 can be used alone or with other words to specify types of beasts or animals, like 野獸 (je5 sau3) meaning wild beast.
It is mostly used in formal or literary contexts, less common in everyday speech where 動物 (dung6 mat6) is used for animals.
獸 emphasizes the idea of a creature's fierceness or wild nature compared to general animals.
You can use 獸 in compound words to describe various beasts or animals in stories or descriptions.
